idea-plugin.name: javafmt
idea-plugin.description:
An opinionated, zero-configuration Java formatter. Replaces IntelliJ's built-in formatter on projects that apply the dev.javafmt.gradle plugin, so Reformat Code and format-on-save route through javafmt automatically.

  • Zero configuration. No style options, no .editorconfig overrides.
  • Version is pinned by the Gradle plugin, so every contributor on the project formats with the same javafmt build.
  • Falls back transparently to the built-in formatter for projects that don't use javafmt.

See the project on GitHub for the Gradle plugin, the CLI, and the style guide.
